fixture.sample_ttl: TTL toDateTime(bucket,'UTC') + toIntervalDay(30); ttl_only_drop_parts=1; partitions by toDate(bucket,'UTC')

method: Real SAMPLES INNER AggregatingMergeTree TTL. Insert 128 August10 expired series and 16 October20 live series, assert effective SHOW CREATE TTL. Synchronously MATERIALIZE TTL with mutations_sync=2; check zero *rows* in old partition and live 16 points, not disappearance of empty old part. Insert one late historical sample Aug10+120, MATERIALIZE TTL again; still 16 live points. Reinsert one previously expired series with current Oct20+120 sample; native avg by(scope)(avg_over_time(metric[1d])) at Oct20+180 returns both old=7.0 and live=100.75, physical 17 points, and after TAGS/TimeRanges FINAL they remain exactly 144 stable series. Read only synthetic localhost table; no production mutation.

negative_method.description: Premature failure required expired partition ID to disappear, but it had 0 rows already. Corrected to assert no expired sample rows and track empty parts, not confuse with data retention.

math_bound: Data-retention invariant is count(physical expired SAMPLES rows)=0; system.parts can retain zero-row parts. In this fixture, a late expired INSERT caused the old partition to have two zero-row parts totalling 2488B, so physical part metadata and bytes do not instantly reach zero. Do not extrapolate accumulation without a long-running background merge/restart test. The series' original TAGS ID remains, enabling new current-period samples to reappear without duplicating TAGS identity after merges.
limitations: Static fixture dates are valid only before 2026-11-18 UTC; time relative to UTC and 30d TTL changes after this window.
Synchronous MATERIALIZE TTL run on a clean isolated single-server; does not prove automatic cleanup scheduling, replicated TTL across shards or fault tolerance.
After one late historical sample a second empty old part remained. This does not prove permanent leaked parts; further merge/restart/part lifecycle tests are required.
No native performance timing or wall/CPU ABBA; this is a semantic and physical retention proof only.
Finite gauge average, no stale NaN/counter-reset, readonly/tenant ACL or multi-tenant controls. No automatic TAGS deletion is recommended.

next_action.step: Investigate whether zero-row expired SAMPLES parts created by TTL are removed by natural merges and/or OPTIMIZE FINAL after restart. Require part counts and bytes at 0/15/30s and after restart. If any residual persists, measure its bound under repeated late writes before claiming persistent metadata bloat. Do not modify source or production.
next_action.stop_condition: Any nonzero expired sample rows, native incorrect value after resumed ID, or unexpected loss of live samples is a correctness failure. Do not treat an empty part as a live sample.
